database_path.description: Path to the SQLite/database file holding resolved hosts and classes.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each DNS host resolution query.

sockets.description: Maximum number of concurrent sockets for parallel DNS queries.

linecache.description: Number of lines to keep cached in memory for performance.

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level. Range 1-3. 0 disables debug mode.

recursive.description: If true, recurse into C, B and A classes when no PTR record exists.

anywhere.description: If true, resolve IPs found anywhere on a line, not just at the start.

mask.description: Mask pattern for recursive hostnames. %i is IP, %c is class owner.

dbfirst.description: If true, check database for resolved entries before sending DNS queries.

dbonly.description: If true, do not send DNS queries, use only database data.

dumpdb.description: If true, dump the database content to STDOUT.

mergedb.description: If true, merge resolved IP/classes from file/STDIN with the database.

expiredb_hours.description: Hours after which database entries expire. 0 means no expiration.

unresolved.description: If true, do not attempt resolution, only list previously unresolved IPs.

progress.description: If true, print a progress bar during execution.

nostats.description: If true, suppress the statistics output after processing.

log_file.description: The log file to process, or '-' for STDIN.
